newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end up on technical rebound.

text.p: * Selected blue chips led by ALI B propel index up
Manila shares finished up on Tuesday on a technical rebound defying earlier predictions of a continued downfall, traders said.
"We saw some people coming in trying to get a bargain but most of these are punters taking advantage of oversold issues," said Felix Barrientos, ING Barings trader.
The main index closed up by 52.25 points, or 1.83 percent, at 2,904.41 points.
Traders said Ayala Land B lifted the index as it closed two pesos higher, at its day-high of 27.50 pesos. Other gainers which pushed up the index were PLDT, Metrobank, and Petron.
Bucking the trend was PNB which continued to be battered, closing weaker by 12.50 pesos at 300 pesos.
All sectors rose. Gainers outnumbered losers 83 to 37 with 57 unchanged issues.
"The market will likely consolidate tomorrow and test the support level of 2,850 points," said Rudsend Alpay, Lippo Securities vice-president for trading operations.
